description.en: I've been passing by for a couple/few years when I would be visiting home, while living abroad. Been smoking for just over 30 years; and wanted to quit. I have tried a V2 e-cig and hated it. Turned off by the idea of e-cigarettes, vaping/ etc.. I finally stopped in at Johnny Vapes, curious and wanting info.; not knowing a darn thing. Spent at least 2, probably closer to 3 hours in there. I do not remember the man's name, but he was awesome! So patient, tolerant, knowledgeable, and nice! He did not try to up-sell me at all... It was all my choice... He even started me out more basic than I decided to go. He just explained everything to me, as in- depth as I kept asking the questions; until I ultimately decided on my PV set up. He let me try like 15 juice flavors... even went back and forth trying to decide between certain ones, before I FINALLY settled on 4. I tell ya, I would have wanted to get rid of me, but he didn't give me that feeling at all. There were other things that made it a great experience too... met the owner... cool and friendly guy... relaxed environment... I haven't had anything near a great vape shop experience since; can't find any even tolerable juices within an hour of where I live; can't find the atomizers I need... So, even though I am across an ocean, I intend to stay a loyal Johnny Vapes customer! I have since ordered multiple times from overseas, and recieved the orders surprisingly fast. And, I've likely been a pain in the butt (but they NEVER acted that way toward me) with all my questions, but they have given me a lot of time and made obvious efforts to excel in their customer service, corresponding with me through facebook and even private email; addressing every one of my questions about gear, explaining technical things, helping me find great juices based on my simply saying what kinds of flavors I might like, and more. All I can say is that these guys (and gals) are awesome!!! (And, yes, I have quit smoking!)
